rows.grounds: state of fasting; compound of nis + āhāra
cause or means of purification; compound pañcāmṛta + aśana

items.question: What purification results from fasting one day and consuming the five nectars?
premises: A person remains without food for one day.
The person then consumes the five nectars.
This combined practice produces ritual purification.
items.inference: Fasting for one day followed by consuming the five nectars brings about purification.
items.plain_english: Fasting for one day, one becomes pure by consuming the five nectars.
